visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and a black t-shirt repeatedly kisses the driver-side window of a black sedan, leaving several oily lip marks. The setting is an indoor parking garage with yellow-painted columns and an EV charging station in the background. (2) The man stands with the driver's door open, looking at the camera with a cheeky smile while pointing to the kiss marks. The lighting is bright and industrial. (3) He is then seen sitting in the driver's seat, holding two cleaning spray bottles (one pink, one blue) with French labeling, presenting them to the viewer. (4) A close-up shot follows where a hand uses a white paper towel to wipe the window glass, removing the lip stains with ease after applying the product. (5) The man leans back toward the closed window and kisses it again, as red heart emojis are edited to appear above his head.
